result:
The task is complete — the memo has been submitted and there's nothing further to request. Here's where things landed:

**Recognized:** USD 36,000 for milestone M1 (Solution design), released from deferred revenue via JE-00305 dated 2026-03-14, supported by the SOW (DOC-0047), the signed M1 acceptance certificate (DOC-0184), and the advance invoice (DOC-0049). Because the entry exceeds the USD 10,000 posting limit, I routed it to you for approval — it's currently `pending_approval`.

**Not recognized:** M2 ($60,000) and M3 ($24,000). M2 is ~80% built, but the SOW says the customer obtains no rights and has no payment obligation until written acceptance, and the PM confirmed nothing is signed and UAT hasn't started. Under ASC 606 that means control hasn't transferred and there's no enforceable right to payment for work to date, so over-time / percentage-of-completion recognition isn't appropriate. It's a point-in-time obligation that will be satisfied on acceptance, expected late April.

**Balances:** Deferred revenue on this contract is now $24,000, which will be applied to M2 on acceptance (with the other $36,000 of M2 billed then). No exceptions were flagged — everything for March on this project was fully supportable. The US "Revenue recognition" checklist item is `in_progress` rather than complete, since it covers all US revenue and JE-00305 still needs your sign-off.
